utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Kira, we’re keeping the repair drive 10 to 2 around the school run—could you swing by and help spread the word a bit too?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but can you confirm Saturday at 10 is actually locked in and who’s bringing the drill before I start spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes—Saturday’s set for 10 to 2, and I’m still confirming who’s bringing the drill, but please do start telling folks the time since that part’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m on my way past now, so I’ll check the sign-up table and let you know how many volunteers they’ve actually got so far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Ira—I’ll keep telling folks the plan and let them know you’re checking the sign-up table to see how many volunteers we’ve got for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—I’ll swing by now and tell you what the sign-up table says, especially whether they need tool help or just setup and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, let’s keep it simple and get the volunteer list nailed down tonight—names, headcount, and who can handle tools versus setup or cleanup. Once we have that, the repair drive plan will be clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. Rosa said she’d send the volunteer list this afternoon, so once it comes through I can help sort names, headcount, and who’s on tools versus setup or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Rey—that’s the right next step. As soon as Rosa sends it, let’s sort it into a clean list tonight so we know exactly where we stand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I commit to anything, can we confirm whether the roof moved ahead of the porch steps and fence, or if those are still first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t heard that order change—last I knew we were set on Saturday at 10 and I’m just coordinating around pickup, so I’d check with Bo or Mara to confirm whether the roof moved ahead.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—before I make plans, let’s confirm with Bo or Mara whether the roof moved ahead of the porch steps and fence.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard they were leaning toward Saturday morning, but Maya was supposed to confirm it—have you heard if she’s picked the day yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m treating it as Saturday at 10 unless Maya says otherwise—I’ve already got the basic tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, that helps—I still hadn’t heard anything official, so I’ll pencil in Saturday at 10 unless Maya changes it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I still haven’t gotten the final confirmation, Dane—they were leaning toward Saturday morning, and I’m checking with Maya so I can let everyone know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—sorry, I came in late; do we know yet whether the porch steps and fence are still first, or did the roof get bumped up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure on the repair order yet either, Dane, but I’m asking Maya about that along with the timing and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—I've half-lost track again, but I’ve got Gus down for the toolkit, spare drill, screws, extension cords, and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s helpful, Noah, though could you keep Gus’s toolkit and drill listed separately from the shared screws and cords? If we don’t mark who’s bringing what clearly, it gets muddled awfully fast once everyone starts unloading.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, good point—I’ll split that out so it’s clear Gus has the toolkit and spare drill, and he’s also bringing the screws, extension cords, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, I’ve got the repair drive noted for 10 to 2, and I’m making a priority list for houses on Maple and Cedar that need repairs most urgently.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal—please mark the start for 9 instead, and keep Maple and Cedar at the top for now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Leo—I’ll update the start to 9 and keep Maple and Cedar at the top of the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by for a little while and mention it to a couple of neighbors, same as I promised. It sounds like they’ve got it fairly well organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That helps a lot, Uli—thanks. I’m walking Maple this afternoon to note the urgent repairs, so any extra word you spread will make Saturday go smoother.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll mention it to a couple along Maple, then. I can only stay a little while on Saturday, but I’ll come by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mina, from what I’ve heard it’s coming along nicely—Mara’s keeping the sign-in sheet tidy, and Ben’s checking labels tonight so the repair pile doesn’t get muddled.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s useful, but do we actually have a confirmed day yet, or is Maya still the one who’s supposed to lock it in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mina, I haven’t heard a confirmed day yet—just that Mara and Ben are keeping things organized in the meantime, so I think Maya may still be the one to lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Cleo, I still can’t find that sign-up sheet, but Rey said they’ll pitch in, so I think the repair drive’s still in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps—I've still only got 9 confirmed, and I’m just tracking tape, gloves, and spare screws, so I still need a firm drill person on the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, right—the drill person. I still haven’t found the sign-up sheet, but with Rey helping I’ll keep asking around and let you know the minute I pin someone down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m all set on my end, Mara—I’ll bring the toolkit, spare drill, screws, extension cords, and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s a huge help, Gus—thank you. We’re keeping it 10 to 2 so it stays clear of school pickup, and I’m glad we’ll have your gear there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Mara—that time works for me, and I’ll be there with the whole lot a little before 10.
